messages.welcomeBody: Invite friends, build your effective invite count, and claim cash rewards. When your friends invite others, you earn bonuses too. Here's how to get started:
messages.contact: Have questions? Contact support for help
messages.step1Body: Go to Tasks to copy your unique invitation link or QR code.
messages.step2Body: Send the link or have friends scan your QR code to register.
messages.step3Body: When a friend registers through your link, they become your Level 1 invite.
messages.step4Body: Once your effective invite count reaches a gift threshold, you can claim it.
messages.step5Body: When your invitees invite others, you earn Level 2 (×0.5) and Level 3 (×0.25) bonuses.
messages.step6Body: Check your progress on the Home or Tasks page. When you qualify, tap to claim — rewards are sent to your crypto wallet.
messages.faq1q: How do I check my invite progress?
messages.faq1a: Open the Tasks page to see your effective invite count and level breakdown.
messages.faq2q: Why is my effective count lower than total invites?
messages.faq2a: Effective invites = Level 1×1.0 + Level 2×0.5 + Level 3×0.25. Different levels have different weights.
messages.faq3q: How do I bind my wallet?
messages.faq3a: Go to Me → Wallet, select your network and enter your crypto wallet address.
messages.faq4q: When will I receive my reward?
messages.faq4a: After claiming, an admin will review and approve it. Once approved, USDT will be sent to your bound wallet.
messages.faq5a: You can find your referral code on the Me page, or copy the share link from the Tasks page.

termsContent.title: 1. General
termsContent.body: Welcome to Gift Haven. By registering, you agree to all terms of this agreement between you and the platform operator. If you do not agree with any provision, please do not register.

termsContent.title: 2. Account Registration
termsContent.body: You must provide true, accurate, and complete information when registering, including email and phone number. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account. Each user is limited to one account.

termsContent.title: 3. Invitation & Rewards
termsContent.body: The platform uses a multi-level invitation system. Effective invites are calculated as Level 1×1.0 + Level 2×0.5 + Level 3×0.25. Rewards require platform review before distribution.

termsContent.title: 4. Prohibited Conduct
termsContent.body: Automated scripts, fake accounts, batch registration, fraud, or coercion to obtain invites are strictly prohibited. Violations may result in account suspension and reward forfeiture.

termsContent.title: 5. Agreement Changes
termsContent.body: The platform reserves the right to modify this agreement at any time. Updated terms take effect immediately upon posting. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

termsContent.title: 6. Termination
termsContent.body: You may stop using the platform at any time. The platform may terminate services for violations, legal requirements, or business changes.

privacyContent.title: 1. Information Collection
privacyContent.body: We collect: (1) Registration data: email, phone, nickname; (2) Usage data: invitation records, claim history, login logs; (3) Device data: browser type, OS, IP address.

privacyContent.title: 2. Information Usage
privacyContent.body: Your data is used for: identity verification, invitation tracking, reward distribution, service improvement, and security. We will not use your data for other purposes without consent.

privacyContent.title: 3. Data Storage & Security
privacyContent.body: Data is stored on encrypted servers with SSL/TLS transmission, encrypted database storage, and access controls. No system is 100% secure.

privacyContent.title: 4. Information Sharing
privacyContent.body: We do not sell, trade, or transfer your personal information to third parties without consent, except as required by law or to protect platform rights.

privacyContent.title: 5. Your Rights
privacyContent.body: You have the right to: access your data, correct inaccuracies, delete your account, export your data, and withdraw consent. Contact support to exercise these rights.

privacyContent.title: 6. Cookies
privacyContent.body: We use cookies to remember login state and analyze usage. You can manage cookie preferences in browser settings.

liabilityContent.title: 1. Service Risk
liabilityContent.body: You understand that using the platform involves inherent risks. The service is provided as-is without warranties of timeliness, security, or accuracy.

liabilityContent.title: 2. Reward Adjustments
liabilityContent.body: Reward mechanisms may be adjusted based on operational needs. The platform reserves final interpretation rights.

liabilityContent.title: 3. Third-Party Links
liabilityContent.body: The platform may contain links to third-party sites. We are not responsible for third-party content or practices.

liabilityContent.title: 4. Force Majeure
liabilityContent.body: The platform is not liable for interruptions caused by natural disasters, war, government actions, cyber attacks, or system failures.

liabilityContent.title: 5. User Disputes
liabilityContent.body: Disputes between users should be resolved between the parties. The platform may assist but assumes no liability.

aboutContent.title: Platform Overview
aboutContent.body: Gift Haven is an innovative invitation-based reward platform. Users share invite links, accumulate effective invites, and claim cash rewards at thresholds with a multi-level bonus system.

aboutContent.title: Key Features
aboutContent.body: Multi-level invites: 3-tier weighted calculation. Rich rewards: from starter bonuses to grand prizes. Transparent tracking: real-time progress, earnings, team structure. Secure & reliable: KYC verification, encryption, review process.

aboutContent.title: Our Mission
aboutContent.body: Make every share rewarding. We believe everyone's social influence has value. Gift Haven converts your network into real earnings while providing brands with efficient social distribution.

aboutContent.title: Contact Us
aboutContent.body: For questions, suggestions, or partnerships: WhatsApp +1 (555) 123-4567. We respond within 24 hours.
